item.title: Trump pauses plans to attack Iranian energy infrastructure, as Nasdaq falls into a correction
item.description: The U.S. president said he would pause attacking Iran’s energy infrastructure for another 10 days late Thursday as stocks tumbled.
item.dc:creator: Joseph Adinolfi
Christine Idzelis

item.title: Trump says he’ll order that TSA officers be paid, in a move that could end long waits at airport security
item.description: President Donald Trump late Thursday said he would sign an executive order to “immediately” pay Transportation Security Administration workers who have gone without pay during a long-running partial government shutdown.
item.dc:creator: Genna Contino
Victor Reklaitis

item.title: Big Tech’s AI fantasy hits a nuclear wall: No fuel, no welders — and no Plan B
item.description: Big Tech is buying small reactors. Washington is buying time. Russia and China? They rule the nuclear-power world.
item.dc:creator: Charlie Garcia

item.title: Investors are snubbing Trump’s Iran pause. Even his Truth Social posts may not save the market.
item.description: Trump hoped his Iran reprieve would bring a stock-market miracle — but investors aren’t buying and time is short.
item.dc:creator: Kenneth Rapoza

item.title: This map shows a crude ticking time bomb that hits much of the world’s oil supply in April
item.description: Disruptions in the flow of oil through the Strait of Hormuz over the past four weeks will unleash a “sequential” shock to global supplies that’ll run from east to west with much of the world taking a hit by April, according to strategists at J.P. Morgan.
item.dc:creator: Myra P. Saefong

media:content.media:description: round bomb with a fuse and a picture of a pump for oil

item.title: Why software stocks proved resilient on a dismal day for tech
item.description: Even as the Nasdaq slid into correction territory, shares of prominent software companies like Salesforce, CrowdStrike and Figma finished the session higher.
item.dc:creator: Hannah Pedone
Emily Bary

item.title: Micron’s stock falls into a bear market — and it’s now the cheapest in the S&P 500
item.description: Micron’s price-to-earnings multiple has compressed dramatically, as earnings expectations have surged and the stock has fallen.
item.dc:creator: Britney Nguyen
Philip van Doorn

item.title: Why Tesla isn’t getting a boost from high gas prices
item.description: Higher EV prices and borrowing costs may be turning prospective buyers away.
item.dc:creator: William Gavin

item.title: Iran’s Kharg Island may be the next battleground, as Trump extends pause on attacking energy infrastructure
item.description: President Trump on Thursday extended his five-day pause on a planned U.S. attack on Iran’s energy infrastructure until April 6, but Iran’s critical oil-export hub, Kharg Island, remains in the spotlight as the next potential target.
item.dc:creator: Myra P. Saefong
Claudia Assis

item.title: My brother says lawyers can get him into a Medicaid nursing home, despite his many assets. Is this a scam?
item.description: “I do not believe there is a way to preserve assets and still qualify for Medicaid.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell
